steps: Open Bot in Settings, then Sending speed
See your tier, how much of it is used in the last 24 hours, how many sends wait, and when the next slot frees
edgeCases: Messaging-limit tier reached (TIER_50/250/1K/10K/100K/unlimited): extra new conversations wait until the next day automatically
Per-number throughput limit (130429 / 131056 pair limit): sends are queued and retried by the throttle
